Streaming chat completion with multiple choice outputs (n > 1)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chatStream({ messages: [{ content: "Hello", role: "user" }], model: "gpt-4o", n: 2, stream: true });
  for await (const resultChunk of result) {
    console.log(resultChunk);
  }
}

void main();
```
